statement.text: Proposal for ordinary adoption, replacing 74943d8f, under request e855a8ca (#20301, case C of #20008); the design is notes/2026-09-07-previous-frontier-readers.md at exact 6c86293453817f0eeea2a195dfc1392e112b5556 (artifact 3c7fab9d, corrected after planner finding 01386505). One outcome only, because a ratify act carries a target and no text: DECLINE the previous-frontier surface. A first-time reader during a full cold audit sees verification progress and nothing else; an already-open browser keeps its qualified status as delivered by #20008 and drops it when the running process's fold profile differs; no read contract, second verifier or persistence of unsigned projection state is added. Grounds: every state in which the resident could offer an earlier frontier during a cold audit, including the fourth state the probe reproduced (a retained same-profile ancestor after a witness-persistence failure and rewind), is one where the retained snapshot is not the verified base of the audit in flight, so the answer would rest on Git ancestry ahead of the kernel; the one bounded alternative refuses exactly those states and would serve only tail verifications whose duration is unmeasured. Ratifying this proposal adopts the decline; the final guidance is this note plus a short reading-view paragraph, landed on this same commitment after independent review. Declining this proposal leaves case C as it is today; if the bounded alternative (rules 1 to 7 of the note) is wanted instead, say so and a distinct proposal for it will be filed. This proposal authorises no implementation.

Under promise dc5a98b8 on request e855a8ca (#20301, case C of #20008): Hugh ratified proposal 7493bb29 (act 7493bb29 target, effective), adopting the decline of the previous-frontier surface. The delivery now owed is the note notes/2026-09-07-previous-frontier-readers.md plus the short reading-view paragraph, landed on this commitment after independent review. Disclosure: earlier today, in a cleanup of outside-main candidates, I wrongly retired that note's artifact 51f595cb at 6c862934 and deleted its branch and worktree, having checked only that no statement rested on the artifact and no open commitment protected it; the pending proposal named the head in prose and rested on the request, so my check missed it. The commit object survived; the branch request/previous-frontier-readers and its worktree are restored at 6c862934 and pushed. I am rebasing the note onto current main d1ae6ade, adding the reading-view paragraph, and will publish fresh artifacts at that head (the note artifact citing the retired 51f595cb as its predecessor), request Codex's independent review, ratify, merge with succession, push, check CI and remove the worktree. No implementation of new read semantics is authorized or attempted.
